sources.title: Foreigners Residence Law No. 76 of 2017
sources.publisher: Official Gazette of Iraq / Ministry of Justice
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Justice hosts the Official Gazette text, Issue No. 4466 of 23 October 2017. It defines federal entry and residence rules but no ordinary-passport nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The provisions of this law shall not be applied to Iraqis and their children who hold foreign passports.

sources.title: Iraqi Electronic Visa: Visa Types and Instructions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Directorate of Residency Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live federal service identifies itself as the Ministry of Interior eVisa site, requests country and passport type, and describes pre-border electronic delivery.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Search for visa requirements by your country and passport type.

sources.title: Electronic Visa
sources.publisher: Consulate General of the Republic of Iraq in Los Angeles / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The currently live Iraqi Foreign Ministry consulate page directs applicants to the federal electronic-visa service, but publishes no ordinary-passport nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Apply for an entry visa to Iraq electronically through the Iraqi electronic visa platform.

sources.title: Iraqi eVisa country selector endpoint
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Directorate of Residency Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The backend used by the live federal eVisa instructions currently returns a successful but empty country array, so it supplies no nationality eligibility result.

sources.title: Visa practices applicable to Turkish citizens
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Foreign Ministry table directly distinguishes ordinary Turkish passports and gives an age-split rule for Iraq.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Irak: 15 yaşından küçük ve 50 yaşından büyük umuma mahsus pasaport hamilleri 30 gün süreyle vizeden muaftır.

sources.title: Emirates travel requirements — Iraq
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, United Arab Emirates
sources.officialityEvidence: The live destination page, modified 9 July 2026, labels Normal passports Electronic Visa while imposing an Emirati outbound travel ban.
sources.supportingExcerpt: UAE citizens are banned from traveling to the Republic of Iraq.

sources.title: Republic of Korea Overseas Safety: Iraq
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of Korea
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Foreign Ministry Iraq page labels the destination travel-prohibited and directly says entry and stay require exceptional passport-use permission.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 이라크는 여행금지 국가로 지정되어 우리 정부의 예외적 여권사용 허가를 발급받지 않고는 입국 및 체류가 불가능합니다.

sources.title: National Security Council travel guidance and statutory destination prohibitions
sources.publisher: National Security Council, State of Israel
sources.officialityEvidence: The current government page, updated 26 March 2026, says Israeli law prohibits citizens from visiting five named destinations including Iraq and makes a visit a criminal offence.
sources.supportingExcerpt: נאסר על אזרחי ישראל לבקר בסוריה, לבנון, ערב הסעודית, תימן ועיראק

conflicts.explanation: The fallback advance-visa label does not represent the current age split: ordinary Turkish passports under 15 and over 50 are visa-free, while ages 15–50 are visa-subject.
The Normal-passport eVisa label cannot be presented as a usable baseline while the same current UAE authority bans Emirati citizens from travelling to Iraq.
The fallback eVisa label omits Korea’s current statutory passport-use restriction, which requires exceptional permission for entry or stay in Iraq.
The fallback advance-visa label cannot represent Israel’s current statutory prohibition on citizen travel to Iraq; the taxonomy has no faithful outbound-prohibition state.
